newsitem.title: USA: Genome to collaborate on gene research.
newsitem.headline: Genome to collaborate on gene research.

text.p: Genome Therapeutics Corp said Tuesday it will collaborate with Creighton University School of Medicine to identify and characterize genes that may facilitate development of new therapeutic approaches for osteoporosis.

In contrast to other genomic company osteoporosis research collaborations, Genome and Creighton said they will initially focus on discovery of a gene associated with high bone mass, the mirror image of osteoporosis.

Osteoporosis is a systemic skeletal disease characterized by low bone mass and increased risk of fracture. the disease affects nearly half of all women over 75 years of age, and about 25 million individuals in the United States.
